title: eurya muricata var. huana
intro: Eurya muricata var. huana, commonly known as the Philippine forest tree, is a plant species native to the Philippines. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, which include treating fever, respiratory infections, and gastrointestinal issues due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antioxidant, antiviral, and anti-inflammatory properties, which help protect against oxidative stress, viral infections, and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Eurya muricata var. huana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
